name: Cervical Facet-Mediated Pain
definition: Neck pain suspected to arise from cervical zygapophyseal joints, sometimes with referred occipital or shoulder-region pain. Clinical tests and imaging alone cannot definitively identify the painful joint.

redFlags.item: Vascular or severe headache red flags

investigations.principle: Imaging does not prove facet pain.
investigations.MRI: MRI for red flags or neurological symptoms.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show arthropathy but are not diagnostic of pain source.

amber: Diagnostic medial branch blocks/radiofrequency procedures are specialist options for selected persistent cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Neck pain suspected to arise from cervical zygapophyseal joints, sometimes with referred occipital or shoulder-region pain. Clinical tests and imaging alone cannot definitively identify the painful joint.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
